rationale: D06 fired on low issuer continuity, but the raw filing explains the discontinuity as genuine portfolio growth and turnover: 2024 had 159 new portfolio companies, 43 exits, end-of-period portfolio companies increased to 275 from 159, and investment count increased to 477 from 252. The source therefore supports the low continuity as a business/source outcome rather than a demonstrated extraction or normalization defect.
